# Founder Operator Library

> Founder Operator Library is a practical publication for founders and operators who run lean teams. It explains AI execution, delegation, hiring trade-offs, operating rhythms and virtual event production with checklists and plain comparisons.

Publisher: Founder Operator Library Editorial Desk. The editorial company that writes, edits and publishes Founder Operator Library.
